metadata.standardization_method: within-window median and MAD robust z-score
metadata.change_score_method: mean absolute frame-to-frame change across supported standardized descriptors
metadata.temporal_smoothing: centered rolling mean applied only within finite change-score runs
metadata.boundary_detection_method: sustained local peaks above robust threshold with minimum phase duration
metadata.micro_phase_merge_rule: candidate boundaries that would create intervals below the minimum duration are removed, preferring the stronger adjacent boundary

phase_decision_rationale.explanation: The rule-based phase procedure did not produce distinct phases because no sustained multivariate transition satisfied the configured phase-boundary rule.
phase_decision_rationale.safety_rationale: Withholding a phase sequence avoids imposing a before/after structure or implying an injury moment that the supported measurements do not establish.
phase_decision_rationale.evidence_preserved: The supported framewise measurements and evidence interval remain visible, including their scope and evidence gaps.
phase_decision_rationale.method_note: This decision was made by a deterministic rule-based procedure. No AI or generative model was used.

analysis_scope.selection_rule: Longest continuous block meeting the configured descriptor-count, duration, and Movement Window fraction safeguards.
analysis_scope.outside_scope_rule: Frames outside this block remain unsegmented and are not silently filled.

sequence_summary: A supported evidence interval covers source frames 5 to 45 (0.67 seconds; 46.6% of the human Movement Window). No sustained multivariate transition met the phase-boundary rule, so this interval is not presented as a phase sequence. Evidence outside this continuous block remains unsegmented. The interval does not establish injury timing.
